soundness_flags.label: thm:observable-boundary
soundness_flags.one_line: \(\mathcal L_{\mathrm{obs}}(d)\) is defined exactly by the existence of a positive reversal-correcting insertion, so maximality and the local-maximizer conclusion merely unfold that definition after substituting \(g_P=\ell_P\).

soundness_flags.label: thm:simultaneous-bands
soundness_flags.one_line: The singleton-recovery claim invokes oracle recovery but omits membership in \(\mathcal L_{\mathrm{obs}}(d)\) or an equivalent existence-of-a-correcting-move premise; separation of inequalities alone does not supply such a move.

soundness_flags.label: def:structural-density / def:base-model
soundness_flags.one_line: The compact model never requires each structural equation to map its parent-domain and innovation support into the declared node interval, so the displayed truncated product density need not be normalized or equal \(P\).

source_verification_receipts.locator: Proceedings record; paper p. 5, Definition 4.2 and Theorem 4.3
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The global-optimality premise is that every pair of orders with smaller \(\operatorname{Rev}(G,\pi)\) has strictly larger fitness, which yields convergence of greedy operations to a true order.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 16, Definition 27 and Theorem 28; p. 17 discussion of density positivity/intersection
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Restricted ANMs require the stated conditional Condition-19 configurations, non-vanishing noise densities, continuous three-times-differentiable mechanisms, and causal minimality; Theorem 28 identifies \(G_0\).
The paper studies scale-invariant \(R^2\)-sortability in ANMs and proves terminal-node \(R^2\) convergence under its random-chain parameter regime.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 5.2 and online Appendix E references
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper shows fitted residuals preserve dHSIC asymptotic ordering and identifies sample splitting as the route to asymptotically valid p-values.
Cross-HSIC has stated null normal limits under its conditions and consistency against fixed alternatives; it does not establish the proposed learned-residual simultaneous GENE procedure.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the self-defining \(\mathcal L_{\mathrm{obs}}\) theorem with an independently stated observable characterization—such as explicit gain inequalities indexed by a graph-agnostic candidate-order predicate—or make the boundary a definition and retain only a nontrivial structural equivalence theorem.

Add an explicit support-closure member property \(f_j(x_{\mathrm{pa}})+\operatorname{supp}(N_j)\subseteq[a_j,b_j]\), and state the simultaneous-band singleton result conditional on \(\mathcal L_{\mathrm{obs}}(d)\) plus its propagated margin condition.

Strengthen the field contribution by extending the primitive certificate beyond disjoint one-edge components to a named nonmatching graph class, with a proved decomposition controlling shared-parent or path interactions.

recommended_next_step: Revise the self-referential observable-boundary target and repair the missing support and navigability premises; then advance the surviving primitive-certificate and strict-separation kernel to Stage 0.
